lead: What you can see in the sky tonight with your own eyes: which planets are up, where to look, and the Moon.
try: Press Use my location. The page lists what is up tonight and which way to look.
points: Planets shine steadily and twinkle less than stars. Venus and Jupiter are the brightest.
The Moon rises about 50 minutes later each day.
You don't need a telescope: go somewhere dark and give your eyes a few minutes to adjust.
